images.caption: Figure 1:A comparison of different video evaluation paradigms. Compared to unconstrained discriminative and generative scoring that suffer from severe scalar drift, RewardVerse inserts a dynamic rubric as an intermediate representation to anchor the scoring process.

header: 3The Phenomenon of Scalar Drift in Video Evaluation

images.caption: Figure 3:Overview of RewardVerse and its two-stage RGPO training. Stage 1 warms up the scorer with seed rubrics using preference and format rewards plus a calibration loss. Stage 2 learns the dynamic rubric generator while continuing scorer calibration.

Figure 7:Qualitative view of dynamic rubrics generated by RewardVerse. Left (Visual Quality): themes and tips stay abstract. Right (Consistency): tips dynamically ground on specific entities in the prompt, illustrating scene-adaptation.
